question: The Hijri Year (Islamic Year) consistently falls about _______ days short of the Solar Year.
solution:
The correct answer is __**11 days**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Hijri Year (Islamic Year) consistently falls about **10 to 12 days short of the Solar Year.**
 
• The** Hijri calendar is a lunar calendar,** consisting of **12 months** and a total of **354 or 355 day**s.
 
• It consists of 12 months, with each month typically having** 29 or 30 days** depending on the moon's sighting.
 
• The Hijri calendar, also known as the Islamic calendar, was **established by Caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab in 638 CE.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Gregorian Calendar** was Founded by **Pope Gregory XIII and established in 1582 CE.**
 
• The Gregorian calendar is a solar calendar with a year consisting of 365 days, or 366 in a leap year.
 
• **Julian Calendar** was Founded by **Julius Caesar and Established in 45 BCE.**
 
• The **Chinese calendar** is a lunisolar calendar used primarily for traditional purposes. It **consists of 12 or 13 months.**
 
• The **Hebrew calendar** is a lunisolar calendar used by Jewish communities. It **consists of 12 months in a regular year and 13 months** in a leap year.
